projects.title: Selected Projects

lebonesa-qrmenu.title: Le Bonesa QR Menu & Management System
lebonesa-qrmenu.summary: A QR menu system built to digitize menu management for a food and beverage business, now in active use.
lebonesa-qrmenu.problem: Printed menus make it harder to add products, change prices, and let customers know when an item is sold out.
lebonesa-qrmenu.solution: Customers can open a digital menu from a QR code. The business can manage and publish menu changes through a password-protected dashboard.
images: Categories and products in Le Bonesa’s digital menu
Categories and product list in the management dashboard
Product editing form in the management dashboard
lebonesa-qrmenu.value: The digital workflow makes product and price updates easier and reduces reliance on printed menus.
lebonesa-qrmenu.imageNote: Product, price, and category information reflects the time these screenshots were captured.

hadoop.title: Big Data Lab
hadoop.summary: Contributed to setting up and configuring a 15-node distributed Hadoop cluster at the R&D Coordination Office of Bursa Uludağ University.
hadoop.problem: The lab needed a distributed environment that could be configured and tested for big data work.
hadoop.solution: As part of the lab team, I helped prepare Linux environments, configure the Hadoop cluster, and integrate data tools.
hadoop.illustrationAlt: Fifteen distributed server nodes with conceptual connections, representing a Hadoop and Linux environment.

lebonesa-website.title: Le Bonesa Business Website
lebonesa-website.summary: A live business website that presents the Le Bonesa brand and its products to customers.
lebonesa-website.problem: The business needed an online destination where customers could get to know the brand and browse its products.
lebonesa-website.solution: I built a public website that brings together the brand presentation and product information.
images: Homepage of the Le Bonesa business website
Product and menu section of the business website
Visit and location section of the business website

yok-academic-crawler.title: YÖK Academic Web Crawler
yok-academic-crawler.summary: An application that automates the collection of data on academic staff at Bursa Uludağ University and exports it in structured formats.
yok-academic-crawler.problem: Academic staff profiles, publications, and awards were spread across multiple pages and needed to be collected together.
yok-academic-crawler.solution: I developed a scraper that navigates paginated results, processes academic records, and exports them to Excel and CSV.
yok-academic-crawler.illustrationAlt: A pipeline that collects web data with Selenium and Python, processes it, and exports an Excel or CSV table.

nlp-complaints.title: NLP Consumer Complaint Classification
nlp-complaints.summary: A project that uses natural language processing and machine learning to classify consumer complaints.
nlp-complaints.problem: Free-text complaints needed to be represented in a form that classification models could use.
nlp-complaints.solution: I preprocessed complaint text, extracted TF-IDF features, and compared classification models.
nlp-complaints.illustrationAlt: Complaint text moves through preprocessing, TF-IDF feature extraction, and classification into generic groups.

store-app.title: StoreApp
store-app.summary: A learning project focused on product management and database operations with ASP.NET Core MVC.
store-app.problem: I wanted to practice how an MVC application handles product records, search, and image uploads.
store-app.solution: I built a product management application for practice, using Entity Framework Core for data access.
store-app.illustrationAlt: A product management interface connects to an ASP.NET Core MVC application and a database through Entity Framework Core.

todo-app.title: TodoApp
todo-app.summary: A task management learning project built around Razor Pages, dependency injection, and data access.
todo-app.problem: I wanted to practice different data access approaches and environment-specific configuration in a task management app.
todo-app.solution: I built a Razor Pages task application with in-memory and Entity Framework data access implementations.
features: In-memory and Entity Framework data access
todo-app.illustrationAlt: A Razor Pages task list uses dependency injection to connect to ITodoStore and in-memory or Entity Framework Core data access.
